claims.claim: Next.js `assetPrefix` affects JavaScript and CSS files loaded from `/_next/static`.
Next.js static export generates static HTML/CSS/JS assets that can be hosted by a static web server.
`window.fetch()` accepts a URL object as its resource parameter.
Tauri can serve files from disk through its asset protocol, which differs from plain browser `file://` verification.
